cards.title: Check in with Corpus Approach at Woodsboro

exchange.text: Corpus Approach, <callsign>, Woodsboro at 2,500 feet, course rules Shamrock, with ATIS <code>.

exchange.speaker: Approach

cards.title: From Woodsboro to Aransas Causeway
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/Port Bay Bridge
instructions: Bayside to Port Bay Bridge: approximately 155°
Passing Port Bay Bridge, descend to 1,000 ft MSL · maintain 240 KIAS
Fly direct to Aransas Causeway, approximately 150°

cards.title: Join the Northern Arrival
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/9 Mile Point
instructions: Establish southbound over the Intracoastal Waterway at 1,500 ft MSL · 240 KIAS
Contact Corpus Approach (UHF CH 8) no later than 9 Mile Point
cards.detail: The binder gives 1,000 ft at the Goliad Arrival's causeway crossing and 1,500 ft on the Northern Arrival, but does not show where to make that climb. Confirm the transition with an instructor.

cards.title: Cross Aransas Pass Causeway
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/Aransas Pass Causeway
instructions: At the causeway, descend to 1,000 ft MSL · maintain 240 KIAS

cards.title: Tower handoff; recovery runway not selected
cards.mapFocus: (KNGP) Corpus Christi NAS/Shamrock Arrivals/PT Shamrock/PT Shamrock
cards.prompt: At Point Shamrock, switch to Navy Corpus Tower (UHF CH 4) and state your recovery intentions. The runway-specific KNGP entry is not included because the arrival flow and recovery runway are not selected.

radio.script: “Navy Corpus Tower, <callsign>, Shamrock, <full stop / touch-and-go / straight-in>.”
